message.content: The film most frequently cited as the “best” of 2020 is **“Parasite”** (2019‑release). It swept the major awards—winning Best Picture, Best Director, Best Original Screenplay, and Best International Feature Film at the 92nd Academy Awards—and received universal critical acclaim for its genre‑blending storytelling, sharp social commentary, and masterful direction by Bong Joon‑ho. While other standout releases that year included *Tenet*, *Soul*, *The Trial of the Chicago 7*, and *1917*, “Parasite” remains the consensus pick for the top film of 2020.
